# Tianjin Yueyang Machinery Manufacturing Co., Ltd.

> Professional manufacturer of spray deposition, spray forming, gas atomization, and powder production equipment with 20+ years of experience. Based in Tianjin, China, serving aerospace, automotive, semiconductor, and electronic packaging industries worldwide.

Tianjin Yueyang (天津越洋机械有限公司) designs and builds advanced metal-forming and powder-production equipment. Core technologies: spray deposition (spray forming), gas-protected gas atomization for metal powders, and spray-deposited tube billet manufacturing. The company holds an R&D team of 30+ members including 5 PhDs and 15 Masters, and is ISO certified with worldwide shipping.

## Core Products
- [Spray Deposition Ingot Equipment](https://www.tianbaoyueyang.com/en/products/plc): Produces aluminum, copper, and steel alloy ingots with fine grain structure (20-50 microns) and no macroscopic segregation.
- [Gas Atomization Powder Equipment](https://www.tianbaoyueyang.com/en/products/sensors): Gas-protected powder preparation for semiconductor, electronic packaging, and optical communication. Produces fine metal powders with 5-15 micron grain size.
- [Spray Deposition Tube Billet Equipment](https://www.tianbaoyueyang.com/en/products/vision): Produces tubular metal blanks of copper, steel, and aluminum alloys with excellent mechanical properties.

## Industries Served
Aerospace, automotive lightweighting, semiconductor devices, electronic packaging, optical communication, new materials R&D, university and research laboratories.

## Key Technical Capabilities
- Spray deposition / spray forming: molten metal atomized with inert gas and deposited onto substrate, producing materials with no macroscopic segregation and uniform 20-50 micron grain size.
- Gas atomization powder production: gas-protected process yielding 5-15 micron fine metal powders with adjustable CTE (coefficient of thermal expansion) and high thermal conductivity.
- Materials produced are suitable for downstream extrusion, forging, and rolling.
